illustration.description: Side-by-side anatomical figures of a man in side profile on a plain white background. The left figure stands slouched, with head bent forward and down and rounded upper back. The right figure stands fully upright with a straight posture and head held high. Both bodies are dark, near-black silhouettes with a warm orange rim glow and subtle muscle detail. The spine is highlighted in bright glowing yellow-orange vertebrae running down the back of each figure, more curved on the left and straight on the right. Soft orange-gold lighting, clean medical-illustration style, glossy digital render, minimal shading, no text, no arrows, no labels.
